tier_reason: Tier D stands (prose only); caveats corrected with the code-reading findings: swapped SetBounds arguments break non-square canvases, ScanT panics with 2 or more threads on unclipped geometry, and winding and clipping are unimplemented so the parity claim against ScanFT compares unequal work.

corrections.caveats: Prose claim only (ScanS at parity with ScanFT, ScanT faster with more threads), no numbers, ScanFT never timed. Code bugs: SetBounds(height, width) argument order swapped against rasterx callers, so non-square canvases paint wrong (all test SVGs are square); ScanT indexes cellWorkers with a negative value and panics when content reaches above the top edge with 2 or more threads; SetWinding and SetClip are no-ops, so no even-odd fill or clipping and counter-wound subpaths lose antialiasing. 1 star, abandoned since 2022-01-17; separate repo from the catalogued srwiley/scanx.
